gallery.alt: A bride and groom share their first dance on a white LED dance floor in a draped, fairy-lit marquee as a burst of white confetti falls over them and the watching guests.
A white starlit DJ booth and backdrop with speakers, lit pillars and light-up LOVE letters beside a white LED dance floor, in a draped room with a fairy-light ceiling and lilac uplighting.
Wedding guests with their arms raised dance on a starlit LED dance floor under purple lighting, with the bride among the crowd.
A white starlit DJ booth flanked by white pillars topped with mirror-ball and moving-head lights, speakers on stands and a large white LED dance floor, in a room washed with red uplighting.
A bride and groom dance in the centre of a timber-beamed barn under strings of fairy lights, with pink heart projections on the walls and guests standing in a circle around them.
A bride and groom dance among a crowd of guests as confetti falls through pink and magenta uplighting in a high-ceilinged room.
A white starlit DJ booth and backdrop with moving-head lights on white pillars, speakers on stands, giant light-up '21' numbers and a white LED dance floor, beside a white sweet cart.
A banqueting room laid with round tables, white cloths and clear chairs under blue uplighting, with white ceiling drapes and snowflake light projections.
A photo booth with a red curtain behind chrome posts and red rope barriers, a 'Photobooth this way' sign, and a stand and table of fancy-dress props and hats.

notes: Logo is a vector reconstruction (potrace via logo_trace.py, 2 layers: #ffffff and #a554ff) of the business's own transparent 964x467 PNG master; no genuine SVG exists. Source was cropped and upscaled 4x and its alpha edge threshold raised (128 -> 180) before tracing to cancel the tool's 1px dilation, so stroke weight matches the original (text ink within ~2%). The faint purple glow around the arcs is not reproduced. The mark is white, so it needs the dark plate.

Showreel is a photo reel (6 stills with a gentle push-in) from the business's own website photos. No direct, HLS or TikTok video exists; all 74 of the business's videos are on YouTube, which is not an allowed download source in this session.

All gallery photos are the business's own uploads on tonypoolediscos.com (Events Shots, Dance Floors & Backdrops and Setting the Scene pages). Wedding photos show identifiable guests; no school or celebrity images were used.
Photo 06 (Hanbury Manor) source is 2340 px wide; others are ~4000 px originals resized to 1600 px.
